payload.title: File:Draconyx Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of Draconyx loureiroi showing known fossil material of the holotype specimen (ML 357). Elements of the right manus and hindleg are mirrored to the left side of the body. Some bones, including a distal humerus and chevron assigned to the holotype by Mateus & Antunes (2001) but not mentioned by Rotatori, Moreno-Azanza & Mateus (2022) are not illustrated. Per the latter publication, a femur initially assigned to Draconyx belongs to a distinct taxon. Scale bar=1 m.
